name: arcanist's magic aura
lore:
# Arcanist’s Magic Aura: The Art of the Veiled Truth

To weave this spell is to practice the ultimate subtlety. While lesser mages shout their power, the Arcanist whispers a lie into the very fabric of the Weave. When casting, the wizard feels the mana turn slippery, like grasping wet silk or shaping smoke with bare hands. It is a delicate layering of "false-light" over the soul of an object or creature.

To those peering through the lens of *Detect Magic*, the aura manifests as a shimmering, oily film—a prismatic distortion that mimics the signature of another school or masks the spark entirely. It is the perfect masquerade.

**Legend of the Ladle**
The Archmage Nystul is said to have perfected this art while evading the Mage-Hunters of the Iron Spire. He famously cloaked a legendary artifact to appear as a common, rusted ladle. The hunters searched his camp thrice, even using the "ladle" to stir their evening pottage, never realizing the *God-Slayer* was resting in their broth. Such is the power of a well-placed lie.
